items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: We were one time with the great Burns of Burns and Allen... We traveled with him

ctx.x: Did you travel with the whole show or --
No, no, just our pack. We were one time with the great Burns of Burns and Allen. He was the act ahead of
us when we did the lower circuit. He had a partner, he was a straight man and his partner was a comedian. George Burns. We traveled with him --
